sources.subject: HHEM model card and licence
sources.finding: HHEM-2.1-Open; Apache-2.0; binary factual-consistency model; exact audited revision de9a5e6ba9ba49531a022dba17e35ffeb2a6fad8.

sources.subject: Official HHEM CPU implementation
sources.finding: Official demo loads the HHEM safetensors into T5ForTokenClassification, uses the frozen premise/hypothesis prompt, and treats softmax class 1 as the supported/consistent score.

sources.subject: HHEM official demo dependency guidance
sources.finding: Official demo declares CPU PyTorch, Transformers 5, safetensors and sentencepiece; its ranges are not a reproducible transitive lock.

sources.subject: FLAN-T5-base foundation
sources.finding: Pinned tokenizer/config foundation revision; Apache-2.0. Foundation weights are not needed for the direct HHEM loading path.

sources.subject: MiniCheck model card and weights
sources.finding: 770M FLAN-T5-Large checkpoint; model-card metadata licence MIT; binary support score.

sources.subject: MiniCheck pinned inference code
sources.finding: Official code joins document and claim with the tokenizer EOS marker, prefixes 'predict: ', compares token IDs 3 (no support) and 209 (support), and returns the support probability.

sources.subject: MiniCheck code licence and dependencies
sources.finding: Code licence Apache-2.0; upstream dependency declarations are not version-pinned.

sources.subject: Standard public GitHub-hosted runners
sources.finding: GitHub documents standard runners as free and unlimited for public repositories; ubuntu-latest public runners are documented as 4 CPU, 16 GB RAM and 14 GB SSD. Repository eligibility and actual capacity still require execution-time checks.
